duas.attributionEn: Imam Ali (as) - taught to Kumayl ibn Ziyad
duas.introEn: Taught by Imam Ali (as) to his companion Kumayl ibn Ziyad and recited on Thursday nights, this is among the most beloved supplications in Shia devotion - an outpouring for mercy and the forgiveness of sins.
duas.sourceCreditEn: Text and recitation courtesy of Duas.org

segments.en: In the Name of Allah, the All-Merciful, the All-Compassionate

segments.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْألُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيٍْء
segments.tr: Allahumma in-ni as-aluka bi-rah-matikal-lati wasi'at kul-la shay
segments.en: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy, which embraces all things;

segments.ar: وَبِقُوَّتِكَ الَّتِي قَهَرْتَ بِهَا كُلَّ شَيٍْء
segments.tr: Wa bi-qu-watikal-lati qahar-ta biha kul-la shay
segments.en: And by Your strength, through which You dominatest all things,
And toward which all things are humble
And before which all things are lowly;

segments.ar: وَبِجَبرُوتِكَ الَّتِي غَلَبْتَ بِهَا كُلَّ شَيٍْء
segments.tr: Wa bi-jabarutikal-lati ghalab-ta biha kul-la shay
segments.en: And by Your invincibility through which You overwhelmest all things,

segments.ar: وَبِعِزَّتِكَ الَّتِي لا يَقُومُ لَهَا شَيْءٌ
segments.tr: Wa bi'izzatikal-lati la yaqumu laha shay
segments.en: And by Your might, which nothing can resist;
And by Your tremendousness, which has filled all things;
by Your force, which towers over all things;

segments.ar: وَبِوَجْهِكَ الْبَاقِي بَعْدَ فَنَاءِ كُلِّ شَيٍْء
segments.tr: Wa bi-waj-hikal-baqi ba'da fana-i kul-li shay
segments.en: And by Your face, which subsists after the annihilation of all things,

segments.ar: وَبِأَسْمَائِكَ الَّتِي مَلأَتْ أَرْكَانَ كُلِّ شَيٍْء
segments.tr: Wa bi-as-ma-ikal-lati malat ar-kana kul-li shay
segments.en: And by Your Names, which have filled the foundations of all things;
And by Your knowledge, which encompasses all things;

segments.ar: وَبِنُورِ وَجْهِكَ الَّذِي أَضَاءَ لَهُ كُلُّ شَيٍْء
segments.tr: Wa bi-nuri waj-hikal-ladhi ada-a lahu kul-lu shay
segments.en: And by the light of Your face, through which all things are illumined!
O Light! O All-holy!
O First of those who are first
And O Last of those who are last!

segments.ar: اللَّهُمَ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تَهتِكُ الْعِصَمَ
segments.en: O Allah, forgive me those sins which tear apart safeguards!

segments.ar: اللَّهُمَ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تُنْزِلُ النِّقَمَ
segments.en: O Allah, forgive me those sins which draw down adversities!

segments.ar: اللَّهُمَ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تُغيِّرُ النِّعَمَ
segments.en: O Allah, forgive me those sins which alter blessings!

segments.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تَحْبِسُ الدُّعَاءَ
segments.en: O Allah forgive me those sins which hold back supplication!

segments.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تَقْطَعُ الرََّّجَاءَ
segments.en: O Allah forgive me those sins which cut down the hopes!

segments.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تُنْزِلُ البَلاءَ
segments.en: O Allah, forgive me those sins which draw down tribulation!

segments.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي كُلَّ ذَنْبٍ أَذْنَبْتُهُ وَكُلَّ خَطِيئَةٍ أَخْطَأْتُهَا
segments.tr: Allahumma-igh-fir liya kul-la dham-bin adhnabtuhu wa kul-la khati-atin akh-tatuha
segments.en: O Allah, forgive me every sin I have committed and every mistake I have made!
O Allah, verily I seek nearness to You through remembrance of You,
And I seek intercession from You with Yourself,

segments.ar: وَأَسْألُكَ بِجُودِكَ أَن تُدْنِيَنِي مِن قُرْبِكَ
segments.tr: Wa as-aluka bi-judika an tud-ni-yani min qur-bik
segments.en: And I ask You through Your munificence to bring me near to Your proximity,
And to provide me with gratitude toward You
And to inspire me with Your remembrance.

segments.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْألُكَ سُؤَالَ خَاضِعٍ مُّتَذَلِّلٍ خَاشِعٍ أَن تُسَامِحَنِي وَتَرْحَمَنِي
segments.tr: Allahumma in-ni as-luka suala khadii'm-mutadhal-lilin kha-shii'n an tusamihani wa tar-hamani
segments.en: O Allah, verily I ask You with the asking of a submissive, abased and lowly man to show me forbearance, to have mercy on me

segments.ar: وَتَجْعلَنِي بِقَسَمِكَ رَاضِياً قَانِعاً، وَفِي جَمِيعِ الأَحْوَاِل مُتَوَاضِعاً
segments.tr: Wa taj-alani bi-qasamika radiyan qani'n wa fi jamii'l-ah-wali mutawadi'aa
segments.en: And to make me satisfied and content with Your appointment and [make me] humble in every state.

segments.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ وَأَسْألُكَ سُؤَالَ مَنِ اشْتَدَّتْ فَاقَتُهُ
segments.tr: Allahumma wa as-aluka suala manish-tad-dat faqatuh
segments.en: O Allah, I ask You the question of one whose indigence is extreme,
And who has stated to You in difficulties his need
And whose desire for what is with You has become great.

segments.tr: Allahumma azuma sul-tanuka wa ala makanuk
segments.en: O Allah, Your force is tremendous, Your place is lofty,
And Your plan is hidden, Your command is manifest,

segments.tr: Wa ghalaba qah-ruka wa jarat qud-ratuk
segments.en: And Your domination is overwhelming, Your power is unhindered
And escape from Your governance is impossible.
O Allah, I find no forgiver of my sins,
Nor concealer of my ugly acts

segments.ar: وَّلا لِشَيٍْء مِّنْ عَمَلِي الْقَبِيحِ بِالْحَسَنِ مُبَدِّلاً غَيْرَكَ
segments.tr: Wa-la lishayim-min amali-yal-qabihi bil-hasani mubad-dilan ghayrak
segments.en: Nor transformer of any of my ugly acts into good acts but You
There is no god but You!
Glory be to You, and Thine is the praise!
I have wronged myself,
And I have been audacious in my ignorance

segments.ar: وَسَكَنتُ إِلَي قَدِيمِ ذِكْرِكَ لِي وَمَنِّكَ عَلَيَّ
segments.tr: Wa sakan-tu ila qadimi dhik-rika li wa man-nika alay
segments.en: And I have depended upon Your ancient remembrance of me and Your favour toward me.
O Allah! O my Protector!
How many ugly things You hast concealed!

segments.ar: وَكَم مِّن فَاِدحٍ مِّنَ البَلاءِ أَقَلْتَهُ
segments.en: How many burdensome tribulations You hast abolished!
And how many stumbles You hast prevented!
And how many ordeals You hast repelled!

segments.ar: وَكَم مِّن ثَنَاٍء جَمِيلٍ لَّسْتُ أَهْلاً لَّهُ نَشَرْتَهُ
segments.tr: Wa kam-min thana-in jamilil-las-tu ah-lal-lahu nashar-tah
segments.en: And how much beautiful praise, for which I was unworthy, You hast spread abroad!
O Allah, my tribulation is tremendous,
And my bad state is excessive,
And my acts are inadequate,
And my fetters have tied me down,
And my far-fetched hopes have held me back from my gain

segments.ar: وَخَدَعَتْنِي الدُّنْيَا بِغُرُورِهَا وَنَفْسِي بِجِنَايَتِهَا وَمِطَاِلي
segments.tr: Wa khada'at-nid-dunya bi-ghururi-ha wa naf-si bi-jinayatiha wa mita-li
segments.en: And this world with its delusions, my own soul with its offences and my delay have deceived me.

segments.ar: يَا سَيِّدِي فَأَسْألُكَ بِعِزَّتِكَ أَن لا يَحْجُبَ عَنْكَ دُعَائِي سُوءُ عَمَلِي وَفِعَاِلي
segments.tr: Ya say-yidi fa-as-aluka bi-i'z-zatika an la yah-juba an-ka du'aa-i suo-u amali wa fi'ali
segments.en: O my Master! So I ask You by Your might not to let my evil works and acts veil my supplication from You,

segments.ar: وَلا تَفْضَحَنِي بِخَفِيِّ مَا اطَّلَعْتَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ سِرِّي
segments.tr: Wa-la taf-dah-ni bi-khafi-yi mat-tala'ta ailayhi min sir-ri
segments.en: And not to disgrace me through the hidden things You knowest of my secrets

segments.ar: وَلا تُعَاجِلْنِي بِالْعُقُوبَةِ عَلَى مَا عَمِلْتُهُ فِي خَلَوَاتِي
segments.tr: Wa-la tu'ajil-ni bil-u'qubati ala ma amil-tuhu fi khalawati
segments.en: And not to hasten me to punishment for what I have done in private:
My evil acts in secrecy and my misdeeds
And my continuous negligence and my ignorance
And my manifold passions and my forgetfulness.

segments.ar: وَكُنِ اَللَّهُمَّ بِعِزَّتِكَ لِي فِي كُلِّ الأَحْوَاِل رَؤُوفاً
segments.tr: Wa kunil-lahumma bi-i'z-zatika li fi kul-lil-ah-wali ra’ufa
segments.en: And by Your might, O Allah, be kind to me in all states
And be gracious to me in all affairs!

segments.ar: إِلَهِي وَرَبِّي مَن لِّي غَيْرُكَ أَسْألُهُ كَشْفَ ضُرِّي وَالْنَّظَرَ فِي أَمْرِي!
segments.tr: Ilahi wa rab-bi mal-li ghayruka as-aluhu kash-fa dur-ri wan-nazara fi am-ri!
segments.en: My God and my Lord! Have I any but You from whom to ask removal of my affliction and regard for my affairs!

segments.ar: إِلَهِي وَمَوْلاي أَجْرَيْتَ عَلَيَّ حُكْماً اتَّبَعْتُ فِيهِ هَوَى نَفْسِي،
segments.tr: Ilahi wa maw-laya aj-rayta alay-ya huk-mant-taba'tu fihi hawa naf-si
segments.en: My God and my Protector! You put into effect through me a decree in which I followed the caprice of my own soul

segments.ar: وَلَمْ أَحْتَرِسْ فِيهِ مِن تَزْيينِ عَدُوِّي،
segments.tr: Wa lam ah-taris fihi min tazyini adu-wi
segments.en: And [I] did not remain wary of adorning my enemy.

segments.ar: فَغَرَّنِي بِمَا أَهْوَى وَأَسْعَدَهُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ القَضَاءُ
segments.tr: Fa-ghar-rani bi-ma ah-wa wa as-adahu ala dha-likal-qada
segments.en: So he deluded me through my soul's caprice and therein destiny favoured him

segments.ar: فَتَجَاوَزْتُ بِمَا جَرَى عَلَيَّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ بَعْضَ حُدُودِكَ
segments.tr: Fa-taja-waztu bi-ma jara alay-ya min dha-lika ba'da hududik
segments.en: So, in what was put into effect through me in that situation, I transgressed some of Your statutes
And disobeyed some of Your commands.

segments.ar: فَلَكَ الْحُجَّةُ عَلَيَّ فِي جَمِيعِ ذَلِكَ
segments.en: So Thine is the argument against me in all of that

segments.ar: وَلا حُجَّةَ لِي فِيمَا جَرَي عَلَيَّ فِيهِ قَضَاؤُكَ،
segments.tr: Wa-la huj-jata li fima jara alay-ya fihi qadauka
segments.en: I have no argument in what Your destiny put into effect through me therein
nor in what Your decree and Your tribulation imposed upon me.

segments.ar: وَقَدْ أَتَيْتُكَ يَا إِلَهِي بَعْدَ تَقْصِيرِي وَإِسْرَافِي عَلَى نَفْسِي
segments.tr: Wa qad ataytuka ya ilahi ba'da taq-siri wa is-rafi ala naf-si
segments.en: Now I have come to You, My God, after my shortcoming and my immoderation toward myself,
Proffering my excuse, regretful,
Broken, apologizing,
Asking forgiveness, repenting,
Acknowledging, submissive, confessing.

segments.ar: لا أَجِدُ مَفَرّاً مِّمَّا كَانَ مِنِّي
segments.en: I find no place to flee from what occurred through me,

segments.ar: وَلا مَفْزَعاً أَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْهِ في أَمْرِي
segments.tr: Wa-la mafza'an atawaj-jahu ilayhi fi am-ri
segments.en: Nor any place of escape to which I may turn in my affairs,

segments.ar: غَيْرَ قَبُولِكَ عُذْرِي، وَإِدخَاِلكَ إِيَاي فِي سَعَةٍ مِّن رَّحْمَتِكَ
segments.tr: Ghayra qabulika u'dhri wa id-khalika i-yaya fi sa'tim-mir-rah-matik
segments.en: Other than Your acceptance of my excuse and Your entering me into the compass of Your mercy.
O Allah, so accept my excuse,
Have mercy upon the severity of my affliction
And release me from the tightness of my fetters,

segments.ar: يَا رَبِّ ارْحَمْ ضَعْفَ بَدَنِي وَرِقَّةَ جِلْدِي وَدِقَّةَ عَظْمِي
segments.tr: Ya rab-bir-ham da'fa badani wa riq-qata jil-di wa diq-qata azmi
segments.en: My Lord, have mercy upon the weakness of my body, the thinness of my skin and the frailty of my bones.

segments.ar: يَا مَنْ بَدَأَ خَلْقِي وَذِكْرِي وَتَرْبِيَتِي وَبِرِّي وَتَغْذِيَتِي
segments.tr: Ya mam bada khal-qi wa dhik-ri wa tar-bi-yati wa biri wa tagh-dhi-yati
segments.en: O You who gave rise to my creation, to the remembrance of me, to the nurture of me, to goodness toward me and to nourishment on me,

segments.ar: هَبْنِي لابْتِدَاءِ كَرَمِكَ وَسَاِلفِ بِرِّكَ بِي
segments.tr: Hab-ni lb-tida-i karamika wa salifi bir-rika bi
segments.en: Bestow upon me for the sake of Your having given rise [to me] with generosity and Your previous goodness to me!

segments.tr: Ya ilahi wa say-yidi wa rab-bi
segments.en: O Allah, my Master and my Lord!
Canst You see Yourself tormenting me with Your fire after I have professed Your Unity

segments.ar: وَبَعْدَ مَا انْطَوَى عَلَيْهِ قَلْبِي مِن مَّعْرِفَتِكَ
segments.tr: Wa ba'da man-tawa ailayhi qal-bi mim-ma'rifatik
segments.en: And after the knowledge of You my heart has embraced,

segments.tr: Wa lahija bihi lisani min dhik-rik
segments.en: And the remembrance of You my tongue has constantly mentioned
And the love of You to which my mind has clung,

segments.ar: وَبَعْدَ صِدْقِ اعْتِرَافِي وَدُعَائِي خَاضِعاً لِّرُبُوبِيَّتِكَ
segments.tr: Wa ba'da sid-qi-a-tirafi wa du'aa-i khadi'aal-li-rububi-yatika
segments.en: And after the sincerity of my confession and my supplication, humble before Your lordship?

segments.ar: هَيْهَاتَ أَنتَ أَكْرَمُ مِنْ أَن تُضَيِّعَ مَن رَّبَّيْتَهُ
segments.tr: Hayhata anta ak-ramu min an tuday-yi'a mar-rab-baytah
segments.en: Far be it from You! You art more generous than that You shouldst squander him whom You hast nurtured,
Or banish him whom You hast brought nigh,
Or drive away him whom You hast given an abode

segments.ar: أَوْ تُسْلِّمَ إِلىَ الْبلاءِ مَن كَفَيْتَهُ وَرَحِمْتَهُ
segments.tr: Aw tus-s-lima ilal-bala-i man kafay-tahu wa rahim-tah
segments.en: Or submit to tribulation him whom You hast spared and shown mercy.

segments.ar: وَلَيْتَ شِعْرِي يَا سَيِّدِي وَإِلَهِي وَمَوْلاي
segments.tr: Wa layta shi'a-ri yay say-yidi wa ilahi wa maw-lay
segments.en: Would that I knew, my Master, My God and my Protector,

segments.ar: أَتُسَلِّطُ النَّارَ عَلَى وُجُوهٍ خَرَّتْ لِعَظَمَتِكَ سَاجِدَةً
segments.tr: Atusal-litun-nara ala wujuhin khar-rat li-azamatika sajidah
segments.en: Whether You wilt give the Fire dominion over faces fallen down prostrate before Your Tremendousness,

segments.ar: وَّعَلَى أَلْسُنٍ نَّطَقَتْ بِتَوْحِيدِكَ صَادِقَةً وَّبِشُكْرِكَ مَادِحَةً
segments.tr: Wa ala al-sunin-nataqat bi-taw-hidika sadiqataw-wa bishuk-rika madihah
segments.en: And over tongues voicing sincerely the profession of Your Unity and giving thanks to You in praise,
And over hearts acknowledging Your Divinity through verification,

segments.ar: وَّعَلَى ضَمَائِرَ حَوَتْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ بِكَ حَتَّى صَارَتْ خَاشِعَةً
segments.tr: Wa ala dama-ira hawat minal-i'l-mi bika hat-ta sarat khashi'ah
segments.en: And over minds encompassing knowledge of You until they have become humble

segments.ar: وَّعَلَى جَواِرحَ سَعَتْ إِلَى أَوْطَانِ تَعَبُّدِكَ طَائِعَةً وَّأَشَارَتْ بِاسْتِغْفَارِكَ مُذْعِنَةً
segments.tr: Wa ala jawariha sa't ila aw-tani ta'b-budika ta-i'ataw-wa asharat bis-tigh-farika mudhi'nah
segments.en: And over bodily members speeding to the places of Your worship in obedience and beckoning for Your forgiveness in submission.

segments.ar: مَّا هَكَذَا الظَّنُّ بِكَ وَلا أُخْبِرْنَا بِفَضْلِكَ عَنكَ
segments.tr: Ma hkadhaz-zan-nu bika wa-la ukh-bir-na bi-fadlika anka
segments.en: No such opinion is held of You! Nor has such been reported - thanks to Your bounty — concerning You,
O All-generous! My Lord,

segments.ar: وَأَنتَ تَعْلَمُ ضَعْفِي عَن قَلِيلٍ مِّن بَلاءِ الدُّنْيَا وَعُقُوبَاتِهَا،
segments.tr: Wa anta ta'lamu da'fi an qalilim-min bala-id-dun-ya wa u'qubatiha
segments.en: And You knowest my weakness before a little of this world's tribulations and punishments,

segments.ar: وَمَا يَجْرِي فِيهَا مِنَ الْمَكَارِهِ عَلَى أَهْلِهَا
segments.tr: Wa ma yaj-ri fiha minal-makarihi ala ah-liha
segments.en: And before those ordeals which befall its inhabitants,

segments.ar: عَلَى أَنَّ ذَلِكَ بَلاءٌ وَّمَكْرُوهٌ، قَلِيلٌ مَّكْثُهُ، يَسِيرٌ بَقَاؤُهُ، قَصِيرٌ مُّدَّتُهُ
segments.tr: Ala an-na dha-lika bala-uw-wa mak-ruhun, qalilum-mak-thuhu, yasirum baqa-uhu, qasirum-mud-datuh
segments.en: Even though it is a tribulation and ordeal whose stay is short, whose subsistence is but little and, whose period is but fleeting.

segments.ar: فَكَيْفَ احْتِمَاِلي لِبَلاءِ الآخِرَةِ وَجَلِيلِ وُقُوعِ الْمَكَارِهِ فِيهَا!
segments.tr: Fa-kayfah-timali li-bala-il-akhirati wa jalili wuqui'l-makarihi fiha!
segments.en: So how can I endure the tribulations of the next world and the great ordeals that occur within it?

segments.ar: وَهُوَ بَلاءٌ تَطُولُ مُدَّتُهُ، وَيَدُومُ مَقَامُهُ، وَلا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْ أَهْلِهِ
segments.tr: Wa huwa bala-un tatulu mud-datuhu, wa yadumu maqamuhu, wa-la yukhaf-fafu an ah-lih
segments.en: For it is a tribulation whose period is long, whose station endures and whose sufferers are given no respite,

segments.ar: لأَنَّهُ لا يَكُونُ إِلاَّ عَنْ غَضَبِكَ وَانتِقَامِكَ وَسَخَطِكَ
segments.tr: Li-an-nahu la yakunu il-la an ghadabika wan-tiqamika wa sakhatik
segments.en: Since it only occurs as a result of Your wrath, Your vengeance and Your anger,

segments.ar: وَهَذَا مَا لا تَقُومُ لَهُ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالأَرْضُ
segments.tr: Wa hadha ma la taqumu lahus-samawatu wal-ardu
segments.en: And these cannot be withstood by the heavens and the earth.
O Master, so what about me?!

segments.ar: وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ الضَّعِيفُ الذَّلِيلُ الْحَقِيرُ الْمِسْكِينُ الْمُسْتَكِينُ
segments.en: For I am Your weak, lowly, base, wretched and miserable slave.

segments.tr: Ya ilahi wa rab-bi wa say-yidi wa maw-lay
segments.en: My God! My Lord! My Master! My Protector!
For which things would I complain to You?

segments.tr: Wa lima minha adij-ju wa ab-ki
segments.en: And for which of them would I lament and weep?
For the pain and severity of chastisement?
Or for the length and period of tribulation?
So if You takest me to the punishments with Your enemies,

segments.tr: Wa jama'ta bayni wa bayna ahli bala-ik
segments.en: And gatherest me with the people of Your tribulation

segments.tr: Wa far-raq-ta bay-ni wa bay-na ahib-ba-ika wa aw-li-ya-ik
segments.en: And separatest me from Your friends and saints,

segments.ar: فَهَبْنِي يَا إِلَهِي وَسَيِّدِي وَمَوْلاي وَرَبِّي صَبَرْتُ عَلَى عَذَابِكَ،
segments.tr: Fa-hab-ni ya ilahi wasay-yidi wa mawlaya wa rab-bi sabar-tu ala adhabika
segments.en: Then suppose, My God, my Master, my Protector and my Lord that I am able to endure Your chastisement,
How can I endure separation from You?

segments.tr: Wa hab-ni sabar-tu ala har-ri narika
segments.en: And suppose that I am able to endure the heat of Your fire,

segments.ar: فَكَيْفَ أَصْبِرُ عَنِ النَّظَرِ إِلَى كَرَامَتِكَ
segments.en: How can I endure not gazing upon Your generosity?

segments.ar: أَمْ كَيْفَ أَسْكُنُ فِي النَّارِ وَرَجَائِي عَفْوُكَ
segments.tr: Am kayfa as-kunu fin-nari wa raja-i af-wuk
segments.en: Or how can I dwell in the Fire while my hope is Your pardon?

segments.ar: فَبِعِزَّتِكَ يَا سَيِّدِي وَمَوْلاي أُقْسِمُ صَادِقاً، لَئِن تَرَكْتَنِي نَاطِقاً
segments.tr: Fabi-i'z-zatika ya say-yidi wa mawlaya uq-simu sadiqal-la-in tarak-tani natiqan
segments.en: So by Your might, my Master and my protector, I swear sincerely, if You leavest me with speech,

segments.ar: لأَضِجَّنَّ إِلَيْكَ بَيْنَ أَهْلِهَا ضَجِيجَ الآمِلِينَ
segments.en: I will lament to You from the midst of the Fire's inhabitants with lamentation of the hopeful;
I will cry to You with the cry of those crying for help;
I will weep to You with the weeping of the bereft;

segments.ar: وَلأُنَادِيَنَّكَ أَيْنَ كُنتَ يَا وَلِيَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.tr: Wa la-unadi-yan-naka ay-na kun-ta ya wali-yal-mu-minin
segments.en: And I will call to You, Where art You, O Sponsor of the believers,
O Goal of the hopes of Your knowers,
O Aid of those who seek assistance,
O Friend of the hearts of the sincere
And O God of all the world's inhabitants!

segments.ar: أَفَتُرَاكَ، سُبْحَانَكَ يَا إِلَهِي وَبِحَمْدِكَ، تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا صَوْتَ عَبْدٍ مُّسْلِمٍ
segments.tr: Afaturaka sub-hanaka ya ilahi wa biham-dika tas-mau' fiha saw-ta ab-dim-mus-limin
segments.en: Canst You see Yourself — Glory be to You My God, and Thine is the praised — hearing within the Fire the voice of a slave surrendered to You,
Imprisoned there because of his violations,
Tasting the favour of its torment because of his disobedience,

segments.tr: Wa hubisa bayna at-baqiha bijur-mih wa jariratih
segments.en: And confined within its levels because of his sin and crime,

segments.ar: وَهُوَ يَضِجُّ إلَيْكَ ضَجِيجَ مُؤَمِّلٍ لِّرَحْمَتِكَ
segments.tr: Wa huwa yadij-ju ilayka dajija muammilil-lirah-mat-k
segments.en: While he laments to You with the lament of one hopeful for Your mercy,
And calls to You with the tongue of those who profess Your Unity
And entreats You by Your lordship!

segments.ar: يَا مَوْلاي فَكَيْفَ يَبقَى فِي الْعَذَابِ وَهُوَ يَرْجُو مَا سَلَفَ مِنْ حِلْمِكَ
segments.tr: Ya mawlay fa-kayfa yabqa fil-adhabi wa huwa yar-ju ma salafa min hil-mik
segments.en: My Protector, so how should he remain in the chastisement, while he has hope for Your previous clemency?

segments.ar: أَمْ كَيْفَ تُؤْلِمُهُ النَّارُ وَهُوَ يَامَلُ فَضْلَكَ وَرَحْمَتَكَ
segments.tr: Am kayfa tu-limuhun-naru wa huwa ya-malu fadlaka wa rah-mataka
segments.en: Or how should the Fire cause him pain while he expects Your bounty and mercy?

segments.ar: أَمْ كَيْفَ يُحْرِقُهُ لَهِيبُهَا وَأَنتَ تَسْمَعُ صَوْتَهُ وَتَرَى مَكَانَهُ
segments.tr: Am kayfa yuh-riquhu lahibuha wa anta tas-mau' saw-tahu wa tara makanah
segments.en: Or how should its flames burn him, while You hearest his voice and seest his place?

segments.ar: أَمْ كَيْفَ يَشْتَمِلُ عَلَيْهِ زَفِيرُهَا وَأَنتَ تَعْلَمُ ضَعْفَهُ
segments.tr: Am kayfa yash-tamilu ailayhi zafiruha wa anta ta'lamu da'fah
segments.en: Or how should its groaning encompass him, while You knowest his weakness?

segments.ar: أَمْ كَيْفَ يَتَقَلْقَلُ بَيْنَ أَطْبَاقِهَا وَأَنتَ تَعْلَمُ صِدْقَهُ
segments.tr: Am kayfa yataqalqalu bayna at-baqiha wa anta ta'lamu sid-qah
segments.en: Or how should he be convulsed among its levels, while You knowest his sincerity?

segments.ar: أَمْ كَيْفَ تَزْجُرُهُ زَبَانِيَتُهَا وَهُوَ يُنَادِيكَ يَا رَبَّهُ
segments.tr: Am kayfa tazjuruhu zabani-yatuha wa huwa yunadika ya rab-bah
segments.en: Or how should its keepers torture him while he calls out to You, O Lord?

segments.ar: أَمْ كَيْفَ يَرْجُو فَضْلَكَ فِي عِتْقِهِ مِنْهَا فَتَتْرُكُهُ فِيهَا
segments.tr: Am kayfa yar-ju fadlaka fi i't-qihi minha fatat-rukuhu fiha
segments.en: Or how should he have hope of Your bounty in freeing him from it, while You abandonest him within it?
Far be it from You! That is not what is expected of You,
Nor what is well-known of Your bounty,

segments.ar: وَلا مُشْبِهٌ لِمَا عَامَلْتَ بِهِ الْمُوَحِّدِينَ مِنْ بِرِّكَ وَإِحْسَانِكَ
segments.tr: Wa-la mush-biha lima amal-ta bihil-muah-hidina mim bir-rika wa ih-sanik
segments.en: Nor it is similar to the goodness and kindness You hast shown to those who profess Your Unity.

segments.ar: فَبِالْيَقِينِ أَقْطَعُ لَوْلا مَا حَكَمْتَ بِهِ مِن تَعْذِيبِ جَاحِدِيكَ
segments.tr: Fa-bial-yaqini aq-tau' law-la ma hakam-ta bihi min ta'dhibi jahidik
segments.en: So I declare with certainty that were it not for what You hast decreed concerning the chastisement of Your deniers

segments.tr: Wa qadayta bihi min ikh-laydi mu'anidik
segments.en: And what You hast foreordained concerning the everlasting home of those who stubbornly resist,
You wouldst make the Fire, all of it, coolness and safety,

segments.ar: وَمَا كَانَ لأَحَدٍ فِيهَا مَقَرّاً وَّلا مُقَاماً
segments.tr: Wa ma kana li-ahadin fiha maqar-raw-wa-la muqama
segments.en: And no one would have a place of rest or abode within it.

segments.ar: لَّكِنَّكَ تَقَدَّسَتْ أَسْمَاؤُكَ أَقْسَمْتَ أَنْ تَمْلأَهَا مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ،
segments.tr: Lakin-naka taqad-dasat as-ma-uka aq-sam-ta an tam-laha minal-kafirina;
segments.en: But You—holy are Your Names—hast sworn that You wilt fill it with the unbelievers,
Both Jinn and men together,
And that You wilt place those who stubbornly resist therein forever.

segments.ar: وَأَنتَ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ قُلْتَ مُبْتَدَئاً، وَّتَطَوَّلْتَ بِالإِنْعَامِ مُتَكَرِّماً:
segments.tr: Wa anta jal-la thana-uka qul-ta mub-tadiwaw-wa tataw-wal-ta bil-in-ami mutakar-rima
segments.en: And You— majestic is Your eulogy— said at the beginning and wernt gracious through kindness as a favour,

segments.ar: أَفَمَن كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَن كَانَ فَاسِقًا ۚ لَّا يَسْتَوُونَ
segments.tr: Afaman kana muminan kaman kana fasiqal-la yas-tawun
segments.en: (What? Is he who has been believer like unto him who has been ungodly? They are not equal)

segments.ar: إِلَهِي وَسَيِّدِي فَأَسْألُكَ بِالْقُدْرَةِ الَّتِي قَدَّرْتَهَا
segments.tr: Ilahi wa say-yidi fa-as-aluka bial-qud-ratil-lati qad-dartaha
segments.en: My God and my Master! So I ask You by the power You hast apportioned

segments.ar: وَبِالْقَضِيَّةِ الَّتِي حَتَمْتَهَا وَحَكَمْتَهَا وَغَلَبْتَ مَنْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرَيْتَهَا
segments.tr: Wa bil-qadi-yatil-lati hatam-taha wa hakam-taha wa ghalab-ta man ailayhi aj-raytaha
segments.en: And by the decision which You hast determined and imposed and through which You hast overcome him toward whom it has been put into effect,

segments.ar: أَن تَهَبَ لِي، فِي هذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ، وَفِي هَذِهِ السَّاعَةِ
segments.tr: An tahaba li fi hadhihil-laylati wa fi hadhihis-sa'ah
segments.en: That You forgivest me in this night and at this hour
Every offence I have committed,
And every sin I have performed,
And every ugly thing I have concealed
And every folly I have enacted
Whether I have hidden or announced it,
Or I have concealed it or manifested it

segments.ar: وَكُلَّ سَيِّئَةٍ أَمَرْتَ بِإِثْبَاتِهَا الْكِرَامَ الكَاتِبِينَ
segments.en: And every evil act which You hast commanded the Noble Writers to record,

segments.ar: الَّذِينَ وَكَّلْتَهُم بِحِفْظِ مَا يَكُونُ مِنِّي
segments.tr: Al-ladhina wak-kal-tahum bi-hif-zi ma yakunu min-ni
segments.en: Those whom You hast appointed to watch over what appears from me

segments.tr: Wa ja'l-tahum shuhudan alay-ya ma' jawarihi
segments.en: And whom You hast made, along with my bodily members, witness against me.

segments.ar: وَكُنتَ أَنتَ الرَّقِيبَ عَلَيَّ مِن وَّرَائِهِمْ،
segments.en: And You wast Yourself the Watcher over me from behind them,
And the Witness of what is hidden from them
But through Your mercy You concealed it
And through Your bounty You veiled it.

segments.ar: وَأَن تُوَفِّرَ حَظِّي مِن كُلِّ خَيْرٍ تُنْزِلُهُ،
segments.tr: Wa an tuwf-fira haz-zi min kul-li khayrin tunziluh
segments.en: [And I ask You] that You bestowest upon me an abundant share of every good You sendest down,
Or kindness You conferrest,
Or goodness You unfoldest,
Or provision You spreadest out,
Or sin You forgivest,
Or error You coverest.

segments.ar: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ
segments.tr: Ya rab-bi ya rab-bi ya rabb
segments.en: My Lord! My Lord! My Lord!

segments.ar: يَا إِلَهِي وَسَيِّدِي وَمَوْلاي وَمَاِلكَ رِقِّي
segments.tr: Ya ilahi wa say-yidi wa maw-laya wa malika riq-qi
segments.en: My God! My Master! My Protector! Owner of my bondage!
O He in whose hand is my forelock!
O He who knows my affliction and my misery!
O He who is aware of my poverty and indigence!

segments.ar: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ
segments.tr: Ya rab-bi ya ya rab-bi ya rabb
segments.en: My Lord! My Lord! My Lord!
I ask You by Your Truth and Your Holiness
And the greatest of Your Attributes and Names,

segments.ar: أن تَجْعَلَ أَوْقَاتِي فِي اللَّيلِ وَالنَّهَارِ بِذِكْرِكَ مَعْمُورَةً،
segments.tr: An taj-ala aw-qati fil-layli wan-nahari bi-dhik-rika ma'murah
segments.en: That You makest my times in the night and the day inhabited by Your remembrance,
And joined to Your service
And my works acceptable to You,

segments.ar: حَتَّى تَكُونَ أَعْمَاِلي وَأَوْرَادِي كُلُّهَا وِرْداً وَّاحِداً،
segments.tr: Hat-ta takuna a'mali wa aw-radi kul-luha wir-daw-wahidan
segments.en: So that my works and my litanies may all be a single litany
And my occupation with Your service everlasting.

segments.ar: يَا سَيِّدِي، يَا مَنْ عَلَيْهِ مُعَوَّلِي
segments.tr: Ya say-yidi ya man ailayhi mu'aw-wali
segments.en: My Master! O He upon whom I depend!
O He to whom I complain about my states!

segments.ar: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ
segments.tr: Ya rab-bi ya rab-bi ya rabb
segments.en: My Lord! My Lord! My Lord!
Strengthen my bodily members in Your service,
And fortify my ribs in determination
And bestow upon me earnestness in my fear of You
And continuity in my being joined to Your service

segments.ar: حَتَّى أَسْرَحَ إِلَيكَ فِي مَيَادِينِ السَّابِقِينَ
segments.en: So that I may move easily toward You in the battlefields of the foremost
And hurry to You among the prominent
And desire fervently Your proximity among the fervently desirous
And move nearer to You with the nearness of the sincere
And fear You with the fear of those who have certitude
And gather with the believers in Your vicinity.

segments.tr: Allahumma wa man aradani bisuo-in farid-hu
segments.en: O Allah, whoever desires evil for me, desire [it] for him!
whoever deceives me-deceive him!

segments.ar: وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ أَحَسَنِ عَبِيدِكَ نَصِيباً عِنْدَكَ
segments.tr: Waj-alni min ahasani abidika nasiban i'ndaka
segments.en: And make me one of the most excellent of Your slaves in Portion from You,
And the nearest of them in station to You
And the most elected of them in proximity to You.

segments.ar: فَإِنَّهُ لا يُنَالُ ذَلِكَ إِلاَّ بِفَضْلِكَ
segments.tr: Fa-in-nahu la yunalu dha-lika il-la bi-fadlik
segments.en: For that cannot be attained except by Your bounty.
And grant generously to me through Your munificence,
And incline toward me with Your splendour
And protect me with Your mercy!
And make my tongue remember You without ceasing
And my heart enthralled by Your love!
And be gracious to me by answering me favourably,
And nullify my slips
And forgive my lapses!
For You hast decreed Your worship for Your servants
And commanded them to supplicate You
And assured them that they would be answered.
So toward You, my Lord, I have turned my face

segments.tr: Wa ilayka ya rab-bi madad-tu yadi
segments.en: And toward You, my Lord, I have extended my hand.
So by Your might, comply with my supplication
And make me attain my desires!
Do not severe my hoping for Your Favours

segments.ar: وَاكْفِنِي شَرَّ الْجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ مِنْ أَعْدَائِي
segments.en: And spare me the evil of my enemies from among the jinn and men!
O He, whose pleasure is quickly achieved!

segments.ar: اغْفِرْ لِمَن لا يَمْلِكُ إِلاَّ الدُّعَاءَ
segments.en: Forgive him who owns nothing but supplication
For You dost what You wilt.
O He whose Name is a remedy,
And whose remembrance is a cure,
And whose obedience is wealth!
Have mercy upon him whose capital is hope
And whose weapon is tears!
O Ample in blessings!
O Repeller of adversities!
O Light of those who are lonely in the darkness!
O Knower who was never taught!

segments.tr: Sal-li ala muhammad wa a-li muhammadin
segments.en: Bless Muhammad and Muhammad's household!
And do with me what is worthy of You!

segments.ar: وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ وَالأَئِمَّةِ الْمَيَامِينَ مِنْ آلِهِ
segments.tr: Wa sal-lallahu ala rasulihi wal-aimmatil-mayamina min a-lihi
segments.en: And Allah bless His messenger and the holy Imams of his household
And give them abundant peace!

duas.whenEn: Daily, and on the Day of Ashura
duas.attributionEn: Imam Hussain (as) - narrated from Imam al-Baqir (as)
duas.purposeEn: Renewing one's stand with Karbala; removing calamities
duas.introEn: The ziyarat of Imam Hussain (as), greeting the martyrs of Karbala and renewing one's allegiance to them. It is recited especially on the Day of Ashura and throughout the year.
