segments.en: In the Name of Allah, the All-Merciful, the All-Compassionate

segments.ar: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.en: Peace be upon you, O Abu-`Abdullah.

segments.ar: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.en: Peace be upon you, O son of Allah’s Messenger.

segments.ar: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيكَ يَا خِيَرَةِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنَ خَيرَتِهِ
segments.tr: Alssalamu alayka ya khiyarata allahi wabna khiyaratihi
segments.en: Peace be upon you, O choicest of Allah and son of His choicest.

segments.ar: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.en: Peace be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful
and son of the chief of the Prophets’ successors.
Peace be upon you, O son of Fatimah
the doyenne of the women of the worlds.

segments.ar: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ثَارَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنَ ثَارِهِ وَٱلْوِتْرَ ٱلْمَوْتُورَ
segments.tr: Alssalamu alayka ya thara allahi wabna tharihi walwitra almawtura
segments.en: Peace be upon you, O vengeance of Allah, son of His vengeance, and the unavenged so far.

segments.ar: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ ٱلأَرْوَاحِ ٱلَّتِي حَلَّتْ بِفِنَائِكَ
segments.tr: Alssalamu alayka wa ala al-arwahi allati hallat bifina'ika
segments.en: Peace be upon you and upon the souls that resided in your courtyard.

segments.ar: عَلَيْكُمْ مِنِّي جَمِيعاً سَلاَمُ ٱللَّهِ أَبَداً
segments.tr: Alaykum minni jami'an salamu allahi abadan
segments.en: Peace of Allah be upon all of you from me forever

segments.tr: Ma baqitu wa baqiya allaylu walnnaharu
segments.en: as long as I am existent and as long as there are day and night.
O Abu-`Abdullah,
unbearable is the sorrow

segments.tr: Wa jallat wa azumat almusibatu bika
segments.en: and excruciating and unbearable is the misfortune of you

segments.tr: Alayna wa ala jami'i ahli al-islami
segments.en: for us and for all the people of Islam.
Excruciating and unbearable has been your misfortune

segments.ar: فِي ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ عَلَىٰ جَمِيعِ أَهْلِ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ
segments.tr: Fi alssamawati ala jami'i ahli alssamawati
segments.en: in the heavens for all the inhabitants of the heavens.

segments.ar: فَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً أَسَّسَتْ أَسَاسَ ٱلظُّلْمِ وَٱلْجَوْرِ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ ٱلْبَيْتِ
segments.tr: Fala'ana allahu ummatan assasat asasa alzzulmi waljawri alaykum ahla albayti
segments.en: So, may Allah curse the people who laid the basis of persecution and wronging against you, O Members of the Household.

segments.ar: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً دَفَعَتْكُمْ عَنْ مَقَامِكُمْ
segments.tr: Wa la'ana allahu ummatan dafa'atkum an maqamikum
segments.en: May Allah curse the people who drove you away from your position

segments.ar: وَأَزَالَتْكُمْ عَنْ مَرَاتِبِكُمُ ٱلَّتِي رَتَّبَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ فِيهَا
segments.tr: Wa azalatkum an maratibikum allati rattabakum allahu fiha
segments.en: and removed you away from your ranks that Allah has put you in.
May Allah curse the people who slew you.
May Allah curse those who paved the way for them to do so
and who made possible for them to fight against you.

segments.tr: Bari'tu ila allahi wa ilaykum minhum
segments.en: I repudiate them in the presence of Allah and You

segments.tr: Wa min ashya'ihim wa atba'ihim wa awliya'ihim
segments.en: and I repudiate their devotees, followers, and loyalists.
O Abu-`Abdullah,
I am at peace with those who are at peace with you

segments.ar: وَحَرْبٌ لِمَنْ حَارَبَكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ
segments.tr: Wa harbun liman harabakum ila yawmi alqiyamati
segments.en: and I am at war against those who have fought against you up to the Resurrection Day.

segments.ar: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ آلَ زِيَادٍ وَآلَ مَرْوَانَ
segments.tr: Wa la'ana allahu ala ziyadin wa ala marwana
segments.en: May Allah also curse the family of Ziyad and the family of Marwan.

segments.tr: Wa la'ana allahu bani umayyata qatibatan
segments.en: May Allah also curse the descendants of Umayyah altogether.
May Allah also curse the son of Marjanah.

segments.tr: Wa la'ana allahu umara bna sa'din
segments.en: May Allah also curse `Umar the son of Sa`d.
May Allah also curse Shimr.

segments.tr: Wa la'ana allahu ummatan asrajat wa aljamat
segments.en: May Allah also curse the people who saddled up, gave reins to their horses,
and masked their faces in preparation for fighting against you.
May my father and mother be ransoms for you.
Extremely insufferable is my commiserations with you;

segments.ar: فَأَسْأَلُ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِي أَكْرَمَ مَقَامَكَ وَأَكْرَمَنِي بِكَ
segments.tr: Fa'as'alu allaha alladhi akrama maqamaka wa akramani bika
segments.en: so, I beseech Allah Who has honored your position and honored me because of you
to endue me with the chance to avenge you

segments.ar: مَعَ إِمَامٍ مَنْصُورٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَيْتِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.tr: Ma'a imamin mansurin min ahli bayti muhammadin
segments.en: with a (Divinely) supported leader from the Household of Muhammad,
peace of Allah be upon him and his Household.
O Allah, (please) make me illustrious in Your sight

segments.ar: بِٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ فِي ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ
segments.tr: Bilhusayni alayhi alssalamu fi alddunya wal-akhirati
segments.en: in the name of al-Husayn, peace be upon him, in this world and in the Hereafter.
O Abu-`Abdullah,

segments.ar: إِنِّي أَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ وَإِلَىٰ رَسُولِهِ
segments.tr: Inni ataqarrabu ila allahi wa ila rasulihi
segments.en: I do seek nearness to Allah, to His Messenger,

segments.tr: Wa ila amiri almu'minina wa ila fatimata
segments.en: to the Commander of the Faithful, to Fatimah,

segments.tr: Wa ila alhasani wa ilayka bimuwalatika
segments.en: to al-Hasan, and to you by means of loyalty to you
and by means of repudiation of those who fought against you
and incurred your hostility,

segments.ar: وَبِٱلْبَرَاءَةِ مِمَّنْ أَسَّسَ أَسَاسَ ٱلظُّلْمِ وَٱلْجَوْرِ عَلَيْكُمْ
segments.tr: Wa bilbara'ati mimman assasa asasa alzzulmi waljawri alaykum
segments.en: and repudiation of those who laid the basis of persecution and wronging against you all.

segments.tr: Wa abra'u ila allahi wa ila rasulihi)
segments.en: I also repudiate, in the presence of Allah and His Messenger,
those who laid the basis of all that,
established their foundations on it,

segments.ar: وَجَرَىٰ فِي ظُلْمِهِ وَجَوْرِهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَعلىٰ أَشْيَاعِكُمْ
segments.tr: Wa jara fi zulmihi wa jawrihi alaykum wa ala ashya'ikum
segments.en: and continued in wronging and persecuting you and your adherents.

segments.tr: Bari'tu ila allahi wa ilaykum minhum
segments.en: In the presence of Allah and you all do I repudiate these.

segments.tr: Wa ataqarrabu ila allahi thumma ilaykum
segments.en: And I seek nearness to Allah and then to you all
by means of declaring loyalty to you and to your loyalists
and declaring repudiation of your enemies
and those who incur animosity of you

segments.tr: Wa bilbara'ati min ashya'ihim wa atba'ihim
segments.en: and repudiation of their adherents and followers.
I am verily at peace with those who have been at peace with you,
I am at war against those who fought against you,
loyalist to those who have been loyalist to you,
and enemy of those who have shown enmity towards you.
So, I beseech Allah Who has endued me with the honor of recognizing you
and recognizing your loyalists
and Who conferred upon me with repudiation of your enemies,

segments.ar: أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مَعَكُمْ فِي ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ
segments.tr: An yaj'alani ma'akum fi alddunya wal-akhirati
segments.en: to include me with you in this world and in the Hereafter

segments.ar: وَأَنْ يُثَبِّتَ لِي عِنْدَكُمْ قَدَمَ صِدْقٍ
segments.tr: Wa an yuthabbita li indakum qadama sidqin
segments.en: and to make firm step of honesty for me with you
in this world and in the Hereafter.

segments.ar: وَأَسْأَلُهُ أَنْ يُبَلِّغَنِيَ ٱلْمَقَامَ ٱلْمَحْمُودَ لَكُمْ عِنْدَ ٱللَّهِ
segments.tr: Wa as'aluhu an yuballighani almaqama almahmuda lakum inda allahi
segments.en: I also beseech Him to make me attain the praiseworthy status that you enjoy with Allah
and to bestow upon me with the chance to take my own vengeance
with a leader of true guidance who is (Divinely) sustained
and expressing the truth from among you.
I also beseech Allah in your names
and in the name of the standing that you enjoy with Him
to recompense me for my commiserations for you
with the most favorite thing that He ever gives as compensation for misfortunes that has afflicted anyone.
(Your) misfortune has been so astounding
and so catastrophic for Islam
and for all the heavens and the entire earth.
O Allah, (please) make me in this situation of mine

segments.ar: مِمَّنْ تَنَالُهُ مِنْكَ صَلَوَاتٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ
segments.tr: Mimman tanaluhu minka salawatun wa rahmatun wa maghfiratun
segments.en: one of those who receive blessings, mercy, and forgiveness from You.

segments.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱجْعَلْ مَحْيَايَ مَحْيَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.tr: Allahumma ij'al mahyaya mahya muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.en: O Allah, (please) make me live my lifetime in the same way as Muhammad and Muhammad’s Household lived

segments.tr: Wa mamati mamata muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.en: and make me die on the same principles on which Muhammad and Muhammad’s Household died.
O Allah, this day
has been regarded as blessed day by the descendants of Umayyah
and by the son of the liver-eater woman,
the accursed and son of the accursed
by the tongue of You and by the tongue of Your Prophet,
Allah’s peace be upon him,
on every occasion and in every situation,

segments.ar: وَقَفَ فِيهِ نَبِيُّكَ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
segments.tr: Waqafa fihi nabiyyuka salla allahu alayhi wa alihi
segments.en: which Your Prophet, Allah’s peace be upon him, attended.

segments.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱلْعَنْ أَبَا سُفْيَانَ وَمُعَاوِيَةَ وَيَزيدَ بْنَ مُعَاوِيَةَ
segments.tr: Allahumma il'an aba sufyana wa mu'awiyata wa yazida bna mu'awiyata
segments.en: O Allah, pour curses upon Abu-Sufyan, Mu`awiyah, and Yazid son of Mu`awiyah.
May Your curse be upon them incessantly and everlastingly.

segments.ar: وَهٰذَا يَوْمٌ فَرِحَتْ بِهِ آلُ زِيَادٍ وَآلُ مَرْوَانَ
segments.tr: Wa hadha yawmun farihat bihi alu ziyadin wa alu marwana
segments.en: This is the day on which the family of Ziyad and the family of Marwan gloated
because they had killed al-Husayn, Allah’s blessings be upon him.
So, O Allah, pour frequent curses upon them
and double for them the painful chastisement.

segments.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَيْكَ فِي هٰذَا ٱلْيَوْمِ
segments.tr: Allahumma inni ataqarrabu ilayka fi hadha alyawmi
segments.en: O Allah, I do seek nearness to You on this day,
on this occasion,
and on all the days of my lifetime,
by repudiating these and invoking Your curses upon them,

segments.tr: Wa bilmuwalati linabiyyika wa ali nabiyyika
segments.en: and by declaring loyalty to Your Prophet and Your Prophet’s Household,
peace be upon him and them.

segments.note: Repeat the following La'n (invocation against the oppressors) one hundred times, or once:

segments.en: O Allah, pour curses upon the foremost persecutor

segments.tr: Zalama haqqa muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.en: who usurped the right of Muhammad and Muhammad’s Household

segments.tr: Wa akhira tabi'in lahu ala dhalika
segments.en: and the last follower who acceded to his deed.

segments.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱلْعَنِ ٱلْعِصَابَةَ ٱلَّتِي جَاهَدَتِ ٱلْحُسَيْنَ
segments.tr: Allahumma il'an al'isabata allati jahadat alhusayna
segments.en: O Allah, pour curses upon the gang that struggled against al-Husayn

segments.tr: Wa shaya'at wa baya'at wa taba'at ala qatlihi
segments.en: and who supported each other against him, paid homage to his enemies, and participated in slaying him.
O Allah, pour curses upon all of them.

segments.note: Repeat the following Salam one hundred times, or once:

segments.ar: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.en: Peace be upon you, O Abu-`Abdullah

segments.tr: Wa ala al-arwahi allati hallat bifina'ika
segments.en: and upon the souls that gathered in your courtyard.
Peace of Allah be upon you from me forever

segments.tr: Ma baqitu wa baqiya allaylu walnnaharu
segments.en: as long as I am existent and as long as there are day and night.

segments.ar: وَلاَ جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ آخِرَ ٱلْعَهْدِ مِنِّي لِزِيَارَتِكُمْ
segments.tr: Wa la ja'alahu allahu akhira al'ahdi minni liziyaratikum
segments.en: May Allah not cause this (visit) to be the last of my visit to you (all).
Peace be upon al-Husayn,
upon `Ali ibn al-Husayn,
upon the sons of al-Husayn,
and upon the companions of al-Husayn.

segments.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ خُصَّ أَنْتَ أَوَّلَ ظَالِمٍ بِٱللَّعْنِ مِنِّي
segments.tr: Allahumma khussa anta awwala zalimin billa'ni minni
segments.en: O Allah, pour special curses on the foremost persecutor
and begin with him first,
and then pour curses on the second, the third, and the fourth.
O Allah, curse Yazid fifthly,

segments.ar: وَٱلْعَنْ عُبَيْدَ ٱللَّهِ بْنَ زِيَادٍ وَٱبْنَ مَرْجَانَةَ
segments.tr: Wal'an ubaydallahi bna ziyadin wabna marjanata
segments.en: and curse `Ubaydullah ibn Ziyad, the son of Marjanah,

segments.tr: Wa umara bna sa'din wa shimran
segments.en: `Umar ibn Sa`d, Shimr,

segments.ar: وَآلَ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ وَآلَ زِيَادٍ وَآلَ مَرْوَانَ
segments.tr: Wa ala abi sufyana wa ala ziyadin wa ala marwana
segments.en: the family of Abu-Sufyan, the family of Ziyad, and the family of Marwan
up to the Resurrection Day.
O Allah, all praise be to You;
the praise of those who thank You for their misfortunes.
All praise be to Allah for my great misfortune.

segments.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱرْزُقْنِي شَفَاعَةَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ يَوْمَ ٱلْوُرُودِ
segments.tr: Allahumma irzuqni shafa'ata alhusayni yawma alwurudi
segments.en: O Allah, (please) grant me the intercession of al-Husayn on the Day of Coming (to You)

segments.tr: Wa thabbit li qadama sidqin indaka
segments.en: and make for me with You a firm step of honesty
with al-Husayn and the companions of al-Husayn

segments.ar: ٱلَّذينَ بَذَلُوٱ مُهَجَهُمْ دُونَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
segments.en: who sacrificed their souls in defense of al-Husayn, peace be upon him.

duas.purposeEn: Seeking nearness to Allah through the Ahl al-Bayt (as)
duas.introEn: A supplication of seeking nearness to Allah through the fourteen Infallibles, from the Holy Prophet (S) to the Imam of our time (atfs), calling on them to intercede. It is often recited on Tuesday nights.
duas.sourceCreditEn: Text and recitation courtesy of Duas.org

segments.en: In the Name of Allah, the All-Merciful, the All-Compassionate

segments.tr: Allahumma inni as'aluka wa atawajjahu ilayka
segments.en: O Allah, I beseech You and turn my face toward You
in the name of Your Prophet; the Prophet of Mercy,

segments.tr: Muhammadin salla allahu alayhi wa alihi
segments.en: Muhammad—may Allah send blessings to him and his Household.
O Abu’l-Qasim!
O Allah’s Messenger!
O Chief of Mercy!
O our master and chief!
We are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O Abu’l-Hasan!
O commander of the Believers!
O `Ali, son of Abu-Talib!
O Allah’s Argument against His creatures!
O our master and chief!
We are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O Fatimah, the Luminous Lady!
O daughter of Muhammad!
O delight of the Messenger’s eyes!
O our chief!
We are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O Abu-Muhammad!
O Hasan the son of `Ali!
O well-Chosen one!
O son of Allah’s Messenger!
O Allah’s Argument against His creatures!
O our master and chief!
we are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O Abu-`Abdullah!
O Husayn the son of `Ali!
O Martyr!
O son of Allah’s Messenger!
O Allah’s Argument against His creatures!
O our master and chief!
we are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O Abu’l-Hasan!
O `Ali the son of al-Husayn!
O Ornament of the Worshippers!
O son of Allah’s Messenger!
O Allah’s Argument against His creatures!
O our master and chief!
we are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O Abu-Ja`far!
O Muhammad the son of `Ali!
O Cleaver [of knowledge]!
O son of Allah’s Messenger!
O Allah’s Argument against His creatures!
O our master and chief!
we are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O Abu-`Abdullah!
O Ja`far the son of Muhammad!
O Veracious!
O son of Allah’s Messenger!
O Allah’s Argument against His creatures!
O our master and chief!
we are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O Abu’l-Hasan!
O Musa the son of Ja`far!
O Suppressor [of rage]!
O son of Allah’s Messenger!
O Allah’s Argument against His creatures!
O our master and chief!
we are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O Abu’l-Hasan!
O `Ali the son of Musa!
O Amicable!
O son of Allah’s Messenger!
O Allah’s Argument against His creatures!
O our master and chief!
we are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O Abu-Ja`far!
O Muhammad the son of `Ali!
O pious and magnanimous!
O son of Allah’s Messenger!
O Allah’s Argument against His creatures!
O our master and chief!
we are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O Abu’l-Hasan!
O `Ali the son of Muhammad!
O guide and pure!
O son of Allah’s Messenger!
O Allah’s Argument against His creatures!
O our master and chief!
we are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O Abu-Muhammad!
O Hasan the son of `Ali!
O immaculate resident of `Askar [city]!
O son of Allah’s Messenger!
O Allah’s Argument against His creatures!
O our master and chief!
we are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O successor of al-Hasan!
O descendant [of the Infallibles] and Argument [of Allah]!
O Riser, Awaited, and Well-guided!
O son of Allah’s Messenger!
O Allah’s Argument against His creatures!
O our master and chief!
we are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O my chiefs and masters!
I am turning my face toward Allah in the names of you [all],
for you are my leaders and my supporters
on the day of my destitution and neediness
before Allah.
I am seeking your advocacy for me before Allah
and seeking your intercession for me before Allah;
so, (please) intercede for me before Allah
and save me from my sins before Allah,
for you are my means to Allah

segments.ar: وَبِحُبِّكُمْ وَبِقُرْبِكُمْ ارْجُو نَجَاةً مِنَ ٱللَّهِ
segments.tr: Wa bihubbikum wa biqurbikum arju najatan mina allahi
segments.en: and through my love for you and my seeking nearness to you do I hope for salvation from Allah.
So, be my hope before Allah.
O my masters! O Allah’s intimate servants!
May Allah bless you all

segments.tr: Wa la'ana allahu a'da'a allahi zalimihim
segments.en: and may Allah curse the enemies of Allah; those who wronged you,
from the past and the last generations.
Respond to us, O Lord of the Worlds!

duas.whenEn: Friday mornings and the four Eids
duas.purposeEn: Longing for the reappearance of Imam al-Mahdi (atfs)
duas.introEn: A lament for the awaited Imam al-Mahdi (atfs), recited on Friday mornings and the four Eids, voicing the believer's longing for the promised reappearance.
duas.sourceCreditEn: Text and recitation courtesy of Duas.org

segments.en: In the Name of Allah, the All-Merciful, the All-Compassionate
All praise be to Allah the Lord of the worlds.

segments.ar: وَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّهِ
segments.tr: Wa salla allahu ala sayyidina muhammadin nabiyyihi
segments.en: May Allah send blessings upon our master Muhammad His Prophet
and upon his Household and may He salute them with thorough salutation.
O Allah, all praise be to You
for Your decree that has been applied

segments.ar: فِي اوْلِيَائِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَخْلَصْتَهُمْ لِنَفْسِكَ وَدِينِكَ
segments.tr: Fi awliya'ika alladhina istakhlastahum linafsika wa dinika
segments.en: to Your vicegerents whom You have purely selected for Yourself and Your religion;

segments.ar: إِِذِ ٱخْتَرْتَ لَهُمْ جَزِيلَ مَا عِنْدَكَ
segments.tr: Idhi ikhtarta lahum jazila ma indaka
segments.en: as You have chosen for them the abundance of what You have in possession;
that is the enduring pleasure

segments.ar: ٱلَّذِي لاََ زَوَالَ لَهُ وَلاَ ٱضْمِحْلاَلَ
segments.tr: Alladhi la zawala lahu wa la idmihlala
segments.en: that neither vanishes nor diminishes,
after You had already stipulated on them to renounce
all the ranks of this lowly world
along with all of its embellishments and ornaments,
and they accepted this stipulation.
As You knew that they would fulfill this stipulation,
You accepted and drew them near to You.
You thus provided them with sublime mention
and obvious approval,
made Your angels descend to them,
honored them with Your revelations,
supported them with Your knowledge,
and made them the channel to You
and the means to winning Your pleasure.
Therefore, You made some of them dwell in Your Garden
until You decided to take him out of there.
You bore another one on in Your Ark

segments.tr: Wa najjaytahu wa man amana ma'ahu
segments.en: and saved him and those who believed with him
from perdition, out of Your mercy.
You took another one as Your intimate friend

segments.ar: وَسَالَكَ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي ٱلآخِرِينَ فَاجَبْتَهُ
segments.tr: Wa sa'alaka lisana sidqin fi al-akhirina fa'ajabtahu
segments.en: and when he asked You to leave behind him a truthful mention, You responded to him
and made that (mention) to be eminent.

segments.tr: Wa ba'dun kallamtahu min shajaratin takliman
segments.en: You spoke to another one from a tree directly

segments.ar: وَجَعَلْتَ لَهُ مِنْ اخِيهِ رِدْءاً وَوَزِيراً
segments.tr: Wa ja'alta lahu min akhihi rid'an wa waziran
segments.en: and decided his brother to be his protector and representative.

segments.tr: Wa ba'dun awladtahu min ghayri abin
segments.en: You made another one to be born without a father,
gave him clear-cut proofs
and aided him with the Sacred Spirit.
For each of them, You gave a code of law,
decided a certain course,
and finely chose successors;
well-trustworthy successors one after another,
each for a certain period,
in purpose of establishing Your religion
and acting as arguments against Your servants,

segments.tr: Wa li'alla yazula alhaqqu an maqarrihi
segments.en: so that the truth should never leave its position
and the wrong should never overcome the people of the truth
and so that none should claim, saying,

segments.ar: لَوْ لاَ ارْسَلْتَ إِِلَيْنَا رَسُولاًَ مُنْذِراً
segments.en: “If only You had sent to us a warning messenger
and established for us a guiding person,

segments.ar: فَنَتَّبِعَ آيَاتِكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ انْ نَذِلَّ وَنَخْزَىٰ
segments.tr: Fanattabi'a ayatika min qabli an nadhilla wa nakhza
segments.en: we should have followed Your signs before that we met humiliation and disgrace!”

segments.ar: إِلَىٰ انِ ٱنْتَهَيْتَ بِٱلامْرِ إِلَىٰ حَبِيبِكَ وَنَجِيبِكَ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.tr: Ila an intahayta bil-amri ila habibika wa najibika muhammadin
segments.en: You then ended the matter with Your most-beloved and well-select one, Muhammad,
may Allah bless him and his Household.
He was—as exactly as You have chosen—
the master of all those whom You created,
the best of all those whom You selected,
the most favorite of all those whom You pointed out,
and the noblest of all those on whom You decided.
So, You preferred him to Your prophets,

segments.tr: Wa ba'athtahu ila alththaqalayni min ibadika
segments.en: sent him to the two dependents (men and jinn) from Your servants,
enabled him to tread on the east and the west of Your lands,
made subservient to him the Buraq (the celestial sumpter),
raised him to Your heavens,
and entrusted with him the knowledge of whatever passed

segments.tr: Wa ma yakunu ila inqida'i khalqika
segments.en: and whatever shall come to pass up to the extinction of Your creatures.
You then granted him victory by means of awe & majesty
ordered (Archangels) Gabriel and Michael
as well as the marked angels to surround him,

segments.ar: وَوَعَدْتَهُ انْ تُظْهِرَ دِينَهُ عَلَىٰ ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِ
segments.tr: Wa wa'adtahu an tuzhira dinahu ala alddini kullihi
segments.en: and promised him to make his faith prevail all other faiths
however much the polytheists may be averse.

segments.ar: وَذٰلِكَ بَعْدَ انْ بَوَّاتَهُ مُبَوَّا صِدْقٍ مِنْ اهْلِهِ
segments.tr: Wa dhalika ba'da an bawwa'tahu mubawwa'a sidqin min ahlihi
segments.en: You did all that after You had settled him in an honest position among his people,

segments.tr: Wa ja'alta lahu wa lahum awwala baytin
segments.en: made for him and them the first house
ever located for the people; that is the house in Bakkah,
blessed and guidance for the worlds.
In it, there are clear-cut proofs.
It is the standing-place of Abraham,
and whoever enters it will be secured.

segments.ar: وَقُلْتَ «إِِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمُ ٱلرِّجْسَ
segments.tr: Wa qulta innama yuridu allahu liyudhhiba ankum alrrijsa
segments.en: You also said, “Allah only desires to keep away the uncleanness from you,
O people of the House,
and to purify you a thorough purifying.”
You then decided the reward of Muhammad,
Your blessings be upon him and his Household,
to be the love for them; as in Your Book

segments.tr: Faqulta qul la as'alukum alayhi ajran
segments.en: You said, “Say: I do not ask of you any reward for it
but love for my near relatives.”

segments.ar: وَقُلْتَ «مَا سَالْتُكُمْ مِنْ اجْرٍ فَهُوَ لَكُمْ.»
segments.tr: Wa qulta ma sa'altukum min ajrin fahuwa lakum
segments.en: You also said, “Whatever reward I have asked of you, that is only for yourselves.”

segments.tr: Wa qulta ma as'alukum alayhi min ajrin
segments.en: You also said, “I do not ask you aught in return

segments.ar: إِلاَّ مَنْ شَاءَ انْ يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلاًَ.»
segments.tr: Illa man sha'a an yattakhidha ila rabbihi sabilan
segments.en: except that he who wills, may take the way to his Lord.”
They (i.e. the Prophet’s Household) have therefore been the way to You
and the course to Your pleasure.
When his (i.e. the Prophet) days passed,

segments.ar: اقَامَ وَلِيَّهُ عَلِيَّ بْنَ ابِي طَالِبٍ
segments.tr: Aqama waliyyahu aliyya bna abi talibin
segments.en: he appointed as successor his vicegerent `Ali the son of Abu-Talib,
Your blessings be upon both of them and their Household,
because he (the Prophet) was the warner
and `Ali was the guide for every people.
So, he (the Prophet) said in the presence of the people,
“As for each one who has taken me as his master,
`Ali is now his master.
O Allah, guard any one who is loyal to `Ali,
be the enemy of any one who antagonizes him,
support any one who supports him,
and disappoint any one who disappoints him.”

segments.ar: وَقَالَ: ”مَنْ كُنْتُ انَا نَبِيَّهُ فَعَلِيٌّ امِيرُهُ.“
segments.tr: Wa qala man kuntu ana nabiyyahu fa'aliyyun amiruhu
segments.en: He also said, “As for any one who has considered me as his Prophet, `Ali is now his commander.”

segments.tr: Wa qala ana wa aliyyun min shajaratin wahidatin
segments.en: He also said, “`Ali and I are of the same tree,

segments.tr: Wa sa'iru alnnasi min shajarin shatta
segments.en: while all the other peoples are from various trees.”

segments.tr: Wa ahallahu mahalla haruna min musa
segments.en: He endued him (i.e. `Ali) with the position that (Prophet) Aaron had with regard to (Prophet) Moses,

segments.ar: فَقَالَ لَهُ: ”انْتَ مِنِّي بِمَنْزِلَةِ هَارُونَ مِنْ مُوسَىٰ
segments.tr: Faqal lahu anta minni bimanzilati haruna min musa
segments.en: saying, “Your position to me is as same as Aaron’s position to Moses (in every thing)
except that there shall be no prophet after me.”

segments.tr: Wa zawwajahu ibnatahu sayyidata nisa'i al'alamina
segments.en: He gave him in marriage his daughter the doyenne of the women of the worlds.

segments.ar: وَاحَلَّ لَهُ مِنْ مَسْجِدِهِ مَا حَلَّ لَهُ
segments.tr: Wa ahalla lahu min masjidihi ma halla lahu
segments.en: He allowed him (alone) to do whatever he himself is allowed to do in his Mosque.
He closed all the doors (to the Mosque) except his (i.e. `Ali) door.
He then entrusted with him his knowledge and his wisdom,
saying, “I am the city of knowledge,
and `Ali is its door.
So, whoever wants this city and wisdom,
must come to it from its door.”

segments.tr: Thumma qala anta akhi wa wasiyyi wa warithi
segments.en: He then said (to `Ali), “You are my brother, successor, and inheritor.
Your flesh is part of my flesh,
your blood is part of my blood,
your peace is my peace,
your war is my war,
and faith is mixed with your flesh and blood
as same as it is mixed with my flesh and blood.

segments.tr: Wa anta ghadan ala alhawdi khalifati
segments.en: On the morrow, you shall be my vicegerent on the (Divine) Pond.
You also settle my debts
and fulfill my commitments.

segments.tr: Wa shi'atuka ala manabira min nurin
segments.en: Your Shi`ah (i.e. adherents) shall be on pulpits of light,
white-faced, around me in Paradise.
They are my neighbors (therein).
Were it not for you `Ali,
true believers would not be recognized after me.”

segments.tr: Wa kana ba'dahu hudan min alddalali
segments.en: Hence, he (i.e. `Ali), after the Prophet, was true guidance against straying off,
light against blindness,
the firmest rope of Allah,
and His straight path.
None would precede him in blood relation (with the Prophet)
or any priority in a religious affair,

segments.ar: وَلاَ يُلْحَقُ فِي مَنْقَبَةٍ مِنْ مَنَاقِبِهِ
segments.tr: Wa la yulhaqu fi manqabatin min manaqibihi
segments.en: and none would ever match him in any item of virtue.
He patterned after the Messenger,
may Allah’s blessings be upon both of them and their Household.
He fought for the sake of true interpretation (of the Qur'an).

segments.ar: وَلاَ تَاخُذُهُ فِي ٱللَّهِ لَوْمَةُ لاَئِمٍ
segments.tr: Wa la ta'khudhuhu fi allahi lawmatu la'imin
segments.en: The blame of any blamer would never stop him from doing anything for the sake of Allah.
He thus exterminated the villains of the Arabs,
killed their heroes,
and eradicated their ferocious fighters.
He therefore filled in their hearts with malice

segments.tr: Badriyyatan wa khaybariyyatan wa hunayniyyatan wa ghayrahunna
segments.en: from the battles of Badr, Khaybar, and Hunayn as well as others.
Therefore, they clang inseparably to opposing him
and attached upon dissenting him
until he (had to) kill those who broke their oath/allegiance, and the unjust, and the apostates"
When he passed away

segments.ar: وَقَتَلَهُ اشْقَىٰ ٱلآخِرِينَ يَتْبَعُ اشْقَىٰ ٱلاوَّلِينَ
segments.tr: Wa qatalahu ashqa al-akhirina yatba'u ashqa al-awwalina
segments.en: and he was killed by the most miserable of all of the late generations who will be attached to the most miserable of the past generations,
the decree of Allah’s Messenger,
may Allah bless him and his Household,
about the leadership of the successive guiding ones was not carried out;
rather, the people insisted on detesting him
and agreed unanimously on rupturing their relations with him
and moving away his descendants (from leadership),

segments.ar: إِِلاَّ ٱلْقَلِيلَ مِمَّنْ وَفَىٰ لِرِعَايَةِ ٱلْحَقِّ فِيهِمْ
segments.tr: Illa alqalila mimman wafa liri'ayati alhaqqi fihim
segments.en: except for a few ones who fulfilled the duty of observing their rights.
Many (of `Ali’s descendants) were therefore slain,
many others were taken as captives,
and many others were banished.
Decrees were thus applied to them
in a form expected to grant them excellent reward for that.
Verily, the earth is Allah’s;
He gives it in inheritance to whomever of His servants that He wishes;
and the end result shall be for the pious.
All glory be to our Lord.
Most certainly, the promise of our Lord shall come to pass.
Allah shall never fail to fulfill His promise.
He is the Almighty, the All-wise.

segments.ar: فَعَلَىٰ ٱلاطَائِبِ مِنْ اهْلِ بَيْتِ مُحَمَّد وَعَلِيٍّ
segments.tr: Fa'ala al-ata'ibi min ahli bayti muhammadin wa aliyyin
segments.en: For the immaculate ones from the household of Muhammad and `Ali,
may Allah bless both of them and their household,
let weepers weep.
For them too, let lamenters lament.
For the like of them, let tears be shed,
screamers scream,
yellers yell,
and wailers wail.
Where is al-Hasan? Where is al-Husayn?
Where are the sons of al-Husayn;
a virtuous one after another,
and a veracious one after another?
Where is the course (to Allah) after a course?
Where is the best after the best?
Where are the rising suns?
Where are the shining moons?
Where are the brilliant stars?
Where are the authorities of the religion
and the foundations of knowledge?
Where is the left by Allah

segments.ar: ٱلَّتِي لاََ تَخْلُو مِنَ ٱلْعِتْرَةِ ٱلْهَادِيةِ
segments.tr: Allati la takhlu min al'itrati alhadiyati
segments.en: that is always represented by individuals from the guiding (Prophetic) offspring?
Where is the one prepared for cutting off the roots of the wrongdoers?
Where is the one awaited for mending every unevenness and crookedness?
Where is the one hoped for removing oppression and aggression?
Where is the one spared for refreshing the duties and traditions?
Where is the one chosen for restoring the faith and the code of law?

segments.tr: Ayna almu'ammalu li'ihya'i alkitabi wa hududihi
segments.en: Where is the one expected to restore to life the Book and its provisions?

segments.tr: Ayna muhyi ma'alimi alddini wa ahlihi
segments.en: Where is the reviver of the elements of the religion and its people?
Where is the one shattering the arms of the aggressors?
Where is the one demolishing the edifices of polytheism and hypocrisy?
Where is the one annihilating the people of wickedness,
disobedience, and tyranny?
Where is the one uprooting the branches of error and insurgence?
Where is the one effacing the traces of evasiveness and personal desires?
Where is the one severing the ropes of fabrication and forgery?
Where is the one terminating the insolent defiant and persistent rebels?

segments.ar: ايْنَ مُسْتَاصِلُ اهْلِ ٱلْعِنَادِ وَٱلتَّضْلِيلِ وَٱلإِلْحَادِ
segments.tr: Ayna musta'silu ahli al'inadi walttadlili wal-ilhadi
segments.en: Where is the one tearing up the people of obstinacy, misleading, and atheism?

segments.tr: Ayna mu'izzu al-awliya'i wa mudhillu al-a'da'i
segments.en: Where is the one ennobling the saints and humiliating the enemies?
Where is the one bringing together (all scattered) words to piety?

segments.ar: ايْنَ بَابُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي مِنْهُ يُؤْتَىٰ
segments.tr: Ayna babu allahi alladhi minhu yu'ta
segments.en: Where is the door of Allah from which Allah is come?

segments.ar: ايْنَ وَجْهُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي إِِلَيْهِ يَتَوَجَّهُ ٱلاوْلِيَاءُ
segments.tr: Ayna wajhu allahi alladhi ilayhi yatawajjahu al-awliya'u
segments.en: Where is the Face of Allah towards whom the saints turn their faces.

segments.ar: ايْنَ ٱلسَّبَبُ ٱلْمُتَّصِلُ بَيْنَ ٱلارْضِ وَٱلسَّمَاءِ
segments.tr: Ayna alssababu almuttasilu bayna al-ardi walssama'i
segments.en: Where is the means of access that is connectedly extended between the earth and the heavens.
Where is the patron of the Conquest Day
and the stretcher of the pennon of true guidance?
Where is the one reunifying the dispersed parts of uprightness and contentment?

segments.ar: ايْنَ ٱلطَّالِبُ بِذُحُولِ ٱلانْبِيَاءِ وَابْنَاءِ ٱلانْبِيَاءِ
segments.tr: Ayna alttalibu bidhuhuli al-anbiya'i wa abna'i al-anbiya'i
segments.en: Where is the one demanding with the vengeance of the Prophets and their sons?
Where is the one demanding with the blood of the one slain in Karbala'?

segments.ar: ايْنَ ٱلْمَنْصُورُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱعْتَدَىٰ عَلَيْهِ وَٱفْتَرَىٰ
segments.tr: Ayna almansuru ala man i'tada alayhi waftara
segments.en: Where is the one granted aid against whomever transgresses and forges lies against him?

segments.ar: ايْنَ ٱلْمُضْطَرُّ ٱلَّذِي يُجَابُ إِِذَا دَعَا
segments.tr: Ayna almudtarru alladhi yujabu idha da'a
segments.en: Where is the distressed who is answered when he prays?

segments.ar: ايْنَ صَدْرُ ٱلْخَلاَئِقِ ذُوُ ٱلْبِرِّ وَٱلتَّقْوَىٰ
segments.tr: Ayna sadru alkhala'iqi dhu albirri walttaqwa
segments.en: Where is the forepart of the creatures who enjoys dutifulness and piety?
Where is the son of the well-chosen Prophet,
the son of `Ali the well-pleased,
the son of Khadijah the glittery lady,
and the son of Fatimah the grand lady?
May my father and mother be ransoms for you.
May my soul be protection and shield for you.
O son of the chiefs drawn near!
O son of the most honorable, outstanding ones!
O son of the guiding and well-guided ones!
O son of the ever-best refined ones!
O son of the all-liberal and all-select ones!
O son of the immaculate and purified ones!
O son of the ample-giving, finely elected ones!
O son of the bounteous, most honorable ones!
O son of light-giving full moons!
O son of beaming lanterns!
O son of piercing flames!
O son of luminous stars!
O son of patent ways!
O son of obvious signs!
O son of perfect knowledge!
O son of renowned traditions!
O son of well-established features!
O son of well-known miracles!
O son of widely witnessed demonstrations!
O son of the straight path!
O son of the great news!

segments.ar: يَا بْنَ مَنْ هُوَ فِي امِّ ٱلْكِتَابِ لَدَىٰ ٱللَّهِ عَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٌ
segments.tr: Yabna man huwa fi ummi alkitabi lada allahi aliyyun hakimun
segments.en: O son of him who is elevated and full of wisdom in the original of the Book with Allah.
O son of signs and manifestations!
O son of apparent points of evidence!
O son of clear-cut and dazzling substantiations!
O son of conclusive arguments!
O son of superabundant bounties!
O son of Taha and the decisive (verses)!
O son of Yasin and al-Dhariyat (the winnowing winds)!
O son of al-Tur (the Mount of Revelation) and al-`ªdiyat (the running steeds)!
O son of him who drew near and then bowed;
he therefore was the measure of two bows or closer still;
nearness and closeness to the Most High and Most Exalted (Lord)!

segments.ar: لَيْتَ شِعْرِي ايْنَ ٱسْتَقَرَّتْ بِكَ ٱلنَّوَىٰ
segments.tr: Layta shi'ri ayna istaqarrat bika alnnawa
segments.en: How I wonder! Where has farness taken you?

segments.ar: بَلْ ايُّ ارْضٍ تُقِلُّكَ اوْ ثَرَىٰ
segments.tr: Bal ayya ardin tuqilluka aw thara
segments.en: Or which land or soil is carrying you?

segments.ar: ابِرَضْوَىٰ اوْ غَيْرِهَا امْ ذِي طُوَىٰٰ
segments.tr: Abiradwa aw ghayriha am dhi tuwa
segments.en: Is it on (Mount) Radwa or elsewhere on (Mount) Dhi-Tuwa?

segments.ar: عَزِيزٌ عَلَيَّ انْ ارَىٰ ٱلْخَلْقَ وَلاَ تُرَىٰ
segments.tr: Azizun alayya an ara alkhalqa wa la tura
segments.en: It is hard for me that I can see all creatures but I can neither see you

segments.ar: وَلاَ اسْمَعُ لَكَ حَسِيساً وَلاَ نَجْوَىٰ
segments.tr: Wa la asma'u laka hasisan wa la najwa
segments.en: nor can I hear any whisper or confidential talk from you!

segments.ar: عَزِيزٌ عَلَيَّ انْ تُحِيطَ بِكَ دُونِيَ ٱلْبَلْوَىٰ
segments.tr: Azizun alayya an tuhita bika duniya albalwa
segments.en: It is hard for me that ordeals encompass you, not me

segments.ar: وَلاَ يَنَالُكَ مِنِّي ضَجِيجٌ وَلاَ شَكْوَىٰ
segments.tr: Wa la yanaluka minni dajijun wa la shakwa
segments.en: and neither cry nor complaint from me can rally round you!

segments.ar: بِنَفْسِي انْتَ مِنْ مُغَيَّبٍ لَمْ يَخْلُ مِنَّا
segments.tr: Binafsi anta min mughayyabin lam yakhlu minna
segments.en: May my soul be ransom for you; for although you are hidden from us, you have never forsaken us.

segments.ar: بِنَفْسِي انْتَ مِنْ نَازِحٍ مَا نَزَحَ عَنَّا
segments.tr: Binafsi anta min nazihin ma nazaha anna
segments.en: May my soul be ransom for you; for although you are away, you have never been away from us.
May my soul be ransom for you; for you are the wish of an eager

segments.tr: Min mu'minin wa mu'minatin dhakara fahanna
segments.en: believing man or woman who mention you and miss you.

segments.ar: بِنَفْسِي انْتَ مِنْ عَقِيدِ عِزٍّ لاَ يُسَامَىٰ
segments.tr: Binafsi anta min aqidi izzin la yusama
segments.en: May my soul be ransom for you; for you are an unmatched pioneer of dignity.

segments.ar: بِنَفْسِي انْتَ مِنْ اثِيلِ مَجْدٍ لاَ يُجَارَىٰ
segments.tr: Binafsi anta min athili majdin la yujara
segments.en: May my soul be ransom for you; for you are an unrivaled origin of glory.

segments.ar: بِنَفْسِي انْتَ مِنْ تِلاَدِ نِعَمٍ لاََ تُضَاهَىٰ
segments.tr: Binafsi anta min tiladi ni'amin la tudaha
segments.en: May my soul be ransom for you; for you are unparalleled center of bounties.

segments.ar: بِنَفْسِي انْتَ مِنْ نَصِيفِ شَرَفٍ لاََ يُسَاوَىٰ
segments.tr: Binafsi anta min nasifi sharafin la yusawa
segments.en: May my soul be ransom for you; for you are unequaled in all-inclusive honor.

segments.ar: إِلَىٰ مَتَىٰ احَارُ فِيكَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ وَإِِلَىٰ مَتَىٰ
segments.tr: Ila mata aharu fika ya mawlaya wa ila mata
segments.en: Until when will I be bewildered about you, O my master, and until when?

segments.ar: وَايَّ خِطَابٍ اصِفُ فِيكَ وَايَّ نَجْوَىٰ
segments.tr: Wa ayya khitabin asifu fika wa ayya najwa
segments.en: In what kind of statement and in what kind of talk can I describe you?

segments.ar: عَزِيزٌ عَلَيَّ انْ اجَابَ دُونَكَ وَانَاغَىٰ
segments.tr: Azizun alayya an ujaba dunaka wa unagha
segments.en: It is hard for me that I can receive answers and words, but you cannot.

segments.ar: عَزِيزٌ عَلَيَّ انْ ابْكِيَكَ وَيَخْذُلَكَ ٱلْوَرَىٰ
segments.tr: Azizun alayya an abkiyaka wa yakhdhulaka alwara
segments.en: It is hard for me that I weep for you but the others disappoint you.

segments.ar: عَزِيزٌ عَلَيَّ انْ يَجْرِيَ عَلَيْكَ دُونَهُمْ مَا جَرَىٰ
segments.tr: Azizun alayya an yajriya alayka dunahum ma jara
segments.en: It is hard for me that what has happened afflict you other than all the others.

segments.ar: هَلْ مِنْ مُعِينٍ فَاطِيلَ مَعَهُ ٱلْعَوِيلَ وَٱلْبُكَاءَ
segments.tr: Hal min mu'inin fa'utila ma'ahu al'awila walbuka'a
segments.en: Is there any helper with whom I may lament and bewail as much as I wish?

segments.ar: هَلْ مِنْ جَزُوعٍ فَاسَاعِدَ جَزَعَهُ إِِذَا خَلاَ
segments.tr: Hal min jazu'in fa'usa'ida jaza'ahu idha khala
segments.en: Is there any aggrieved one whom I can help in grief when he becomes tired?

segments.ar: هَلْ قَذِيَتْ عَيْنٌ فَسَاعَدَتْهَا عَيْنِي عَلَىٰ ٱلْقَذَىٰ
segments.tr: Hal qadhiyat aynun fasa'adat-ha ayni ala alqadha
segments.en: Is there any eye moling out and thus my eye may help it to mol out more?

segments.ar: هَلْ إِِلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ احْمَدَ سَبِيلٌ فَتُلْقَىٰ
segments.tr: Hal ilayka yabna ahmada sabilun fatulqa
segments.en: Is there any way to meet you, O son of Ahmad (the Prophet)?

segments.ar: هَلْ يَتَّصِلُ يَوْمُنَا مِنْكَ بِعِدَةٍ فَنَحْظَىٰ
segments.tr: Hal yattasilu yawmuna minka bi'idatin fanahza
segments.en: Will our day be promised to catch your day and we will thus achieve our hope?
When will we be able to join your refreshing springs and we will then be satiated?
When will we quench our thirst from your fresh water,
because thirst has been too long?

segments.tr: Mata nughadika wa nurawihuka fanuqirra aynan
segments.en: When will we accompany you in coming and going so that our eyes will be delighted?

segments.ar: مَتَىٰ تَرَانَا وَنَرَاكَ وَقَدْ نَشَرْتَ لِوَاءَ ٱلنَّصْرِ تُرَىٰ
segments.tr: Mata tarana wa naraka wa qad nasharta liwa'a alnnasri tura
segments.en: When will you see us and we see you spreading the pennon of victory?

segments.ar: اتَرَانَا نَحُفُّ بِكَ وَانْتَ تَؤُمُّ ٱلْمَلَا
segments.tr: Atarana nahuffu bika wa anta ta'ummu almala'a
segments.en: Can it be that we surround you while you are leading the groups,
after you will have filled in the earth with justice,

segments.tr: Wa adhaqta a'da'aka hawanan wa iqaban
segments.en: tasted your enemies humiliation and punishment,

segments.tr: Wa abarta al'utata wa jahadata alhaqqi
segments.en: annihilated the insolent defiant and the deniers of the truth,
cut off the roots of the arrogant,
eradicated the sources of the wrongdoers,

segments.ar: وَنَحْنُ نَقُولُ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
segments.tr: Wa nahnu naqulu alhamdu lillahi rabbi al'alamina
segments.en: and we keep on saying, “All praise be to Allah the Lord of the worlds?”
O Allah, You are verily the reliever from agonies and ordeals.
To You do I complain about the transgressions against me, for You alone are worthy of receiving complaints,
and You are alone the Lord of the Hereafter and this world.

segments.ar: فَاغِثْ يَا غِيَاثَ ٱلْمُسْتَغِيثِينَ عُبَيْدَكَ ٱلْمُبْتَلَىٰ
segments.tr: Fa'aghith ya ghiyatha almustaghithina ubaydaka almubtala
segments.en: So, (please) aid Your agonized worthless servant, O Aide of those who seek aid,

segments.tr: Wa arihi sayyidahu ya shadida alquwa
segments.en: grant him (i.e. Your servant) chance to see his master, O Lord of mighty prowess,

segments.tr: Wa azil anhu bihi al-asa waljawa
segments.en: remove from him misfortune and anguish, in the name of his master,

segments.ar: وَبَرِّدْ غَلِيلَهُ يَا مَنْ عَلَىٰ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱسْتَوَىٰ
segments.tr: Wa barrid ghalilahu ya man ala al'arshi istawa
segments.en: and satisfy his thirst, O He Who is established on the Throne
and He to Whom is the return and the final goal.

segments.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ وَنَحْنُ عَبِيدُكَ ٱلتَّائِقُونَ إِلَىٰ وَلِيِّكَ
segments.tr: Allahumma wa nahnu abiduka altta'iquna ila waliyyika
segments.en: O Allah, we are Your servants who are fervently willing to meet Your vicegerent,
who reminds of You and Your Prophet;
and whom You have created as haven and refuge for us,

segments.tr: Wa aqamtahu lana qiwaman wa ma'adhan
segments.en: You have appointed as foundation and source of protection for us,
and whom You have made to be the leader of the believers among us.
So, (please) convey to him greetings and salutations from us,

segments.tr: Wa zidna bidhalika ya rabbi ikraman
segments.en: endue us with more honor, O my Lord, through that,

segments.tr: Waj'al mustaqarrahu lana mustaqarran wa muqaman
segments.en: decide his settlement among us to be settlement and dwelling for us,

segments.tr: Wa atmim ni'mataka bitaqdimika iyyahu amamana
segments.en: and perfect Your bounty by making him occupy the leading position before us
so that You shall allow us to enter the gardens of Your Paradise
and to accompany the martyrs from among Your elite ones.

segments.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.tr: Allahumma salli ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.en: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad;([1])

segments.tr: Wa salli ala muhammadin jaddihi wa rasulika
segments.en: and send blessings upon Muhammad his grandfather and Your messenger;
the senior master,
upon his father the junior master,
upon his grandmother the grand veracious lady
Fatimah the daughter of Muhammad,
peace be upon him and his Household,

segments.ar: وَعَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱصْطَفَيْتَ مِنْ آبَائِهِ ٱلْبَرَرَةِ
segments.tr: Wa ala man istafayta min aba'ihi albararati
segments.en: upon his dutiful fathers whom You have chosen (over all others),
and upon him with such most favorable, most perfect,
most thorough, most permanent,
most abundant, and most plentiful

segments.ar: مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ احَدٍ مِنْ اصْفِيَائِكَ
segments.tr: Ma sallayta ala ahadin min asfiya'ika
segments.en: blessings that You have ever sent upon any of Your elite ones
and well-chosen ones among Your creatures.

segments.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ صَلاَةً لاََ غَايَةَ لِعَدَدِهَا
segments.tr: Wa salli alayhi salatan la ghayata li'adadiha
segments.en: And (please) bless him with such blessings whose number is infinite,
whose quantity is never-ending,
and whose time is interminable.
O Allah! Through him, establish all rights,
refute the entire wrong,
grant triumph to Your loyalists,
humiliate Your enemies,

segments.tr: Wa sil allahumma baynana wa baynahu
segments.en: establish, O Allah, between him and us
a connection that leads us to accompany his ancestors,
include us with those who will take their vengeance
and keep constant under their shadow,

segments.tr: Wa a'inna ala ta'diyati huquqihi ilayhi
segments.en: help us fulfill our duties towards him,
exert all efforts in obedience to him
and avoiding disobeying him,
bestow upon us with the favor of attaining his pleasure,

segments.tr: Wa hab lana ra'fatahu wa rahmatahu
segments.en: and grant us his kindness, mercy,
prayer (for us), and his goodness

segments.ar: مَا نَنَالُ بِهِ سَعَةً مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ
segments.tr: Ma nanalu bihi sa'atan min rahmatika
segments.en: in an amount due to which we will gain a good deal of Your mercy
and achievement with You.
And, through him, render our prayers admitted,
our sins forgiven,
and our supplications responded.
And, through him too, make our sustenance expanded for us,
our distresses relieved,
and our needs granted.
And (please) receive us with Your Noble Face,
approve of our seeking nearness to You,
and have a merciful look at us
by which we will win perfect honor with You;
and, after that, do not ever take it away from us, in the name of Your magnanimity,
and give us a drink from the Pond of his grandfather,
may Allah bless him and his Household,
from his own cup and with his own hand,
such a replete, satiating,
pleasant, and wholesome drink
after which we shall never suffer from thirst.
O most merciful of all those who show mercy!

duas.purposeEn: A pledge of allegiance to Imam al-Mahdi (atfs)
duas.introEn: A morning pledge of allegiance to Imam al-Mahdi (atfs). It is narrated that whoever recites it for forty mornings is counted among the helpers of the awaited Imam.
duas.sourceCreditEn: Text and recitation courtesy of Duas.org

segments.en: In the Name of Allah, the All-Merciful, the All-Compassionate
O Allah the Lord of the Great Light,
the Lord of the Elevated Throne,
the Lord of the swollen ocean,
the Revealer of the Torah, the Gospel, and the Psalms,
the Lord of shade and heat,
the Revealer of the Great Qur'an,
and the Lord of the Archangels,
the Prophets, and the Messengers:
O Allah, I beseech You in Your Noble Name,
in the Light of Your Luminous Face
and Your Eternal Kingdom.
O Ever-living! O Self-Subsistent!

segments.ar: أَسْأَلُكَ بِٱسْمِكَ ٱلَّذِي أَشْرَقَتْ بِهِ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتُ وَٱلأَرَضُونَ
segments.tr: As'aluka bismika alladhi ashraqat bihi alssamawatu wal-araduna
segments.en: I beseech You in the name of Your Name with which the heavens and the earth have lit up

segments.ar: وَبِٱسْمِكَ ٱلَّذِي يَصْلَحُ بِهِ ٱلأَوَّلُونَ وَٱلآخِرُونَ
segments.tr: Wa bismika alladhi yasluhu bihi al-awwaluna wal-akhiruna
segments.en: and in Your Name with which the past and the coming generations have become upright!
O He Who has been always alive before the existence of all living things!

segments.tr: Wa ya hayyan ba'da kulli hayyin
segments.en: O He Who shall be alive after the extinction of all living things!

segments.tr: Wa ya hayyan hina la hayyu
segments.en: O He Who has been always alive even when there was nothing else alive!

segments.tr: Ya muhyiya almawta wa mumita al-ahya'i
segments.en: O He Who revives the dead ones and causes the living ones to die!

segments.ar: يَا حَيُّ لا إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
segments.tr: Ya hayyu la ilaha illa anta
segments.en: O Ever-living! There is no god save You.

segments.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ بَلِّغْ مَوْلاَنَا ٱلإِمَامَ ٱلْهَادِيَ ٱلْمَهْدِيَّ ٱلْقَائِمَ بِأَمْرِكَ
segments.tr: Allahumma balligh mawlana al-imama alhadiya almahdiyya alqa'ima bi'amrika
segments.en: O Allah, convey to our master Imam al-Mahdi, the guide who is to undertake Your orders,

segments.ar: صَلَوَاتُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰ آبَائِهِ ٱلطَّاهِرِينَ
segments.tr: Salawatu allahi alayhi wa ala aba'ihi alttahirina
segments.en: may Allah’s blessings be upon him and upon his immaculate fathers,
on behalf of all of the believing men and women
in the east and west of the earth
and in plains, mountains,
lands, and seas,
and on behalf of my parents
(convey to him) blessings that are as weighty as Allah’s Throne,
as much as the ink of His Words,

segments.ar: وَمَا أَحْصَاهُ عِلْمُهُ وَأَحَاطَ بِهِ كِتَابُهُ
segments.tr: Wa ma ahsahu ilmuhu wa ahata bihi kitabuhu
segments.en: and as many as that which is counted by His knowledge and encompassed by His Book.

segments.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُجَدِّدُ لَهُ فِي صَبِيحَةِ يَوْمِي هٰذَا
segments.tr: Allahumma inni ujaddidu lahu fi sabihati yawmi hadha
segments.en: O Allah, I update to him in the beginning of this day
and throughout the days of lifetime a pledge,

segments.ar: عَهْداً وَعَقْداً وَبَيْعَةً لَهُ فِي عُنُقِي
segments.tr: Ahdan wa aqdan wa bay'atan lahu fi unuqi
segments.en: a covenant, and allegiance to which I commit myself

segments.ar: لا أَحُولُ عنها وَلا أَزُولُ أَبَداً
segments.tr: La ahulu anhu wa la azulu abadan
segments.en: and from which I neither convert nor change.
O Allah, (please do) make me of his supporters,
sponsors, defenders,
and those who hurry in carrying out his instructions,
those who comply with his orders,
those who uphold him,
those who precede others to implementing his will,
and those who will be martyred before him.

segments.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ حَالَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ ٱلْمَوْتُ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلْتَهُ عَلَىٰ عِبَادِكَ حَتْماً مَقْضِيّاً
segments.tr: Allahumma in hala bayni wa baynahu almawtu alladhi ja'altahu ala ibadika hatman maqdiyyan
segments.en: O Allah, if death that You have made inevitably and certainly incumbent upon Your servants stands between me and him,
then (please do) take me out of my grave using my shroud as dress,
unsheathing my sword,
holding my lance in my hand,

segments.ar: مُلَبِّياً دَعْوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِي فِي ٱلْحَاضِرِ وَٱلْبَادِي
segments.en: and responding to the call of the Caller who shall announce (his advent) in urban areas and deserts.
O Allah, (please do) show me his magnificent mien
and his praiseworthy forehead,
delight my eyes by letting me have a look at him.
And (please) expedite his relief,
make his reappearance easy,
clear a spacious space for him,
guide me to follow his course,
give success to his issues,
and confirm his strength.
O Allah, construct Your lands through him
and refresh Your servants through him,
For You have said, and true are Your words:
“Corruption has appeared in the land and the sea
on account of what the hands of men have wrought.”
So, O Allah, (please) show us Your vicegerent,
the son of Your Prophet,
and the namesake of Your Messenger,
peace be upon him and his Household,

segments.ar: حَتَّىٰ لا يَظْفَرَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنَ ٱلْبَاطِلِ إِلاَّ مَزَّقَهُ
segments.tr: Hatta la yazfara bishay'in min albatili illa mazzaqahu
segments.en: so that he shall tear up any wrong item that he will face

segments.tr: Wa yahiqqa alhaqqa wa yuhaqqiqahu waj'alhu
segments.en: and shall confirm and approve of the truth.
O Allah, (please) make him the shelter to whom Your wronged servants shall resort,

segments.ar: وَنَاصِراً لِمَنْ لا يَجِدُ لَهُ نَاصِراً غَيْرَكَ
segments.tr: Wa nasiran liman la yajidu lahu nasiran ghayraka
segments.en: the supporter of those who cannot find any supporter save You,

segments.ar: وَمُجَدِّداً لِمَا عُطِّلَ مِنْ أَحْكَامِ كِتَابِكَ
segments.tr: Wa mujaddidan lima uttila min ahkami kitabika
segments.en: the reviver of the laws of Your Book that have been suspended,

segments.ar: وَمُشَيِّداً لِمَا وَرَدَ مِنْ أَعْلامِ دِينِكَ وَسُنَنِ نَبِيِّكَ
segments.tr: Wa mushayyidan lima warada min a'lami dinika wa sunani nabiyyika
segments.en: and the constructor of all signs of Your religion and instructions of Your Messenger,

segments.tr: Salla allahu alayhi wa alihi waj'alhu
segments.en: peace be upon him and his Household, that he will see.

segments.ar: ٱللَّهُمَّ مِمَّنْ حَصَّنْتَهُ مِنْ بَأُسِ ٱلْمُعْتَدِينَ
segments.tr: Allahumma mimman hassantahu min ba'si almu'tadina
segments.en: O Allah, (please) include him with those whom You protect from the domination of the aggressors.
O Allah, (please) delight Your Prophet Muhammad,
peace be upon him and his Household,

segments.tr: Biru'yatihi wa man tabi'ahu ala da'watihi
segments.en: as well as all those who followed him in his promulgation by making (us) see him,
and (please) have mercy upon our humiliation after him.

segments.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱكْشِفْ هٰذِهِ ٱلْغُمَّةَ عَنْ هٰذِهِ ٱلأُمَّةِ بِحُضُورِهِ
segments.tr: Allahumma ikshif hadhihi alghummata an hadhihi al-ummati bihudurihi
segments.en: O Allah, (please) relieve this community from the (current) grief through presenting him
and expedite his advent for us:

segments.tr: Innahum yarawnahu ba'idan wa narahu qariban
segments.en: “Surely, they think it to be far off, and We see it nigh.”
[do all that] In the name of Your mercy; O most merciful of all those who show mercy.

segments.ar: الْعَجَلَ ٱلْعَجَلَ يَامَوْلايَ يَا صَاحِبَ ٱلزَّمَانِ
segments.tr: Al'ajala al'ajala ya mawlaya ya sahiba alzzaman
segments.en: (We pray for Your) earliest advent, earliest advent, O Patron of the Age.
